top_strength: Rep efficiently gathered logistics details (addresses, property type, parking, bedroom/room count, box count, packing needs, special items) and correctly identified this as a 2,500 sq ft move requiring a virtual walkthrough rather than an immediate quote.
coaching_note: On intake calls like this, ask the two-concerns question ('movers not showing on time, or damage to items — are either a concern for you?') before diving into logistics, and deliver the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with permission and confirmation, even though the call is routing to a walkthrough — both come before probing on the v4 card and build trust early.
